void modbus_set_bits_from_bytes(uint8_t *dest,
                                int idx,
                                unsigned int nb_bits,
                                const uint8_t *tab_byte)
{
    unsigned int i;
    int shift = 0;

    /*@ loop invariant idx_lower: (integer)idx <= (integer)i;
      @ loop invariant i_upper: (integer)i <= (integer)idx + (integer)nb_bits;
      @ loop invariant shift_range: 0 <= shift <= 7;
      @ loop invariant shift_values: shift == 0 || shift == 1 || shift == 2 ||
      @   shift == 3 || shift == 4 || shift == 5 || shift == 6 || shift == 7;
      @ loop invariant shift_pow: 1 << shift <= 2147483647;
      @ loop invariant written_bits: \forall integer k;
      @   0 <= k < (integer)i - (integer)idx ==>
      @     dest[idx + k] == 0 || dest[idx + k] == 1;
      @ loop assigns i, shift, dest[idx .. idx + (integer)nb_bits - 1];
      @ loop variant (integer)idx + (integer)nb_bits - (integer)i;
      @*/
    for (i = idx; i < idx + nb_bits; i++) {
        dest[i] = tab_byte[(i - idx) / 8] & (1 << shift) ? 1 : 0;
        /* gcc doesn't like: shift = (++shift) % 8; */
        shift++;
        shift %= 8;
    }
}
